exposure: myocardial revascularization close to TAVI procedure
outcome: Acute kidney injury (AKI) after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI)
cohort: The study included 1535 consecutive patients who underwent Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI) from the observational multicentric 'Magna Graecia' TAVI registry.
finding: Although high values of current AKI risk scores were significantly associated with TAVI-related AKI, they lacked sufficient diagnostic accuracy, with independent risk factors identified including myocardial revascularization, self-expanding prostheses, atrial fibrillation, contrast media administration, and transfusion.
